review_unsupported_claims: Rationale says that mentioning data quality incidents 'partially corresponds' to bias monitoring. 6.2 'მონაცემთა ხარისხის ინციდენტებს' concerns data quality (completeness, accuracy, etc.), not bias (გადახრა), so it is a stretch to treat it as partial coverage.
review_comment: The document never mentions გადახრა/bias monitoring; 6.2 lists 'მონაცემთა ხარისხის ინციდენტებს' and 9.2 only bans direct protected attributes, neither of which is monitoring of bias identified during data processing. The cited clause is unrelated to bias, so 'none' fits better than 'partial', which agrees with the gold gap (no Art. 9¹ content). The proposal bolts a bias sentence onto the monitoring report clause, which is a workable but thin fix.
